title: Tooth extraction
what: The dentist removes a tooth with local numbing. It usually takes a few minutes.
why: When a tooth cannot be saved: badly damaged, infected, or loose, or before dentures or braces.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat 1 to 2 hours before your visit. After the extraction, you cannot eat for 2 hours.

prepare.title: Alcohol
prepare.text: No alcohol for a day before and after.

bring: An X-ray of the tooth, if you had one
steps: The dentist checks the tooth and takes an X-ray if needed
A numbing injection is given. In a few minutes your gum and lip go numb
The dentist loosens the tooth and takes it out
A gauze pad is placed on the socket. Bite down on it
feel: Pressure and cracking sounds are normal. It should not hurt
If it hurts, tell the dentist and you will get more numbing
after: Keep biting on the gauze for 20 to 30 minutes
Do not eat for 2 hours. For the first day: no hot or spicy food, no straws, no smoking
Do not rinse hard on the first day. A blood clot needs to stay in the socket
Swelling and mild pain for 2 to 3 days are normal
red_flags: Bleeding that does not stop for more than an hour
Swelling and pain that get worse after day 3, fever, or a bad smell from the socket

faq.q: Can I rinse my mouth after an extraction?
faq.a: Not on the first day. You could wash out the clot, and the socket may get inflamed. After that, only gentle mouth baths, as your dentist advises.
